title: Letter to Delaware Governor Matt Meyer re: Artificial Intelligence Company proposal
venue: House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform
quote: We are concerned that Delaware's AIC proposal could be used to protect powerful AI companies and their investors from responsibility for reckless harmful actions, while also protecting non-transparent forces seeking anticompetitive regulatory capture behind state AI initiatives.

title: "No human at the helm": Delaware plan would let AI agents run entire businesses
quote: A Delaware proposal to let companies be operated by AI agents would help the firms' human owners evade legal responsibility for reckless and harmful actions taken by the AI, US Rep. James Comer (R-Ky.) told Delaware Governor Matt Meyer in a letter yesterday.

title: Exclusive: Delaware wants to let AI agents run their own companies

title: Client throws "No Payment schemes found." on a 402 whose WWW-Authenticate has no Payment challenge, so x402 fallback never runs
quote: The client tries protocols in order mpp -> x402 -> mcp with no catch around the MPP step, so the throw leaves fetch before x402 runs.

title: SessionFetch throws on 402 responses without an MPP Payment challenge

title: fix(mpp): pass through non-session payment responses
quote: An unrelated HTTP 402 could throw in SessionFetchClient when the response carried no MPP challenge. Extract actual Payment auth schemes in the wrapper and return the original response when no matching session is offered.
